title: Frontend: Typewriter Message
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Typewriter Message. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({message="Hello"}). Advance reveals one Unicode code point per activation in [data-testid="message"]. Pause stops Advance; Reset clears and resumes. Clamp at full text. This injected-step exercise avoids wall-clock timing.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Track a visible boundary and derive the prefix from a pre-segmented character array.
alternativeApproaches: Add pause/resume using a monotonic deadline rather than assuming each timer fires on time.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Empty message; emoji; changed text mid-run.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
